lines.zh: 影子跟着我走，一步不落。
lines.en: My shadow walks with me, never falling behind.

lines.zh: 梦魇第一层，脚步声只有我。
lines.en: First layer of the Nightmare, only my footsteps sound.
Every stretch I walk, another me appears.
Soft steps, don't startle the original.

lines.zh: 我在找下一个分裂的空隙。
lines.en: I'm looking for the next gap to split into.
This ground feels like an old dream underfoot.
The shadow behind me has caught up again.
Wherever I walk, my shadow spreads.
Don't count me, I'm countless.
I patrol my own territory.
One step, one me, slowly now.

lines.zh: 梦魇的石廊，我走得很熟。
lines.en: I know these nightmare halls by heart.
Standing long, even my shadow grows.
I count the selves behind me.
Quiet, waiting for the original to wake.
This layer of nightmare is breathing.
When still, I look most real.
My shadow keeps watch around me.
Another is about to split off.
I hear my own echo.
Standing in the mist, no need to move.
Who the original is, long forgotten.
You can't tell which one is me, can you.
Keep looking, and I'll make another.
There's fear in your eyes, good.
Come closer, look at the shadow.
Hit me? First find the original.
Counting me? You'll never finish.
Your shadow belongs to me too.
Don't blink, I'll split.
You've seen this face many times.
Stare at me, and you're staring at the wrong one.
Pain? Shadows don't cry out.
The one you hit is about to scatter.
One less me, still plenty left.
The wound will split into new ones.
The original has noted that blow.
Shatter me, you only shatter a shadow.
I step back, the shadow fills in.
Don't gloat, you still must find the original.
The shell hurts, not me.
Again, see how many you can hit.
Food? I only split new shadows.
Don't wave food at me, I don't need it.
That thing won't lure me away.
When I'm hungry, I only split.
What's in your hand is useless to shadows.
Put it away, I only chase the original.
Smells fine, but I can't taste it.
I don't eat, I only replicate.
Trade food for your life? Dream on.
Shadows don't chew.
Hit me, and you hit a crowd.
Don't get too close, shadows stick.
What you touched might not be me.
One bump, and there's another of me.
Back off, don't step on my shadow.
This layer doesn't welcome collisions.
The harder you hit, the faster I split.
Did you hit the original? Guess.
The shadow scatters and gathers again.
Don't crowd, not enough room to split.
I only share shadows with the original.
Mate? Shadows don't do that.

lines.zh: 我的延续靠分裂，不靠你。
lines.en: I continue by splitting, not by you.

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我只复制自己。
lines.en: Stay back, I only copy myself.

lines.zh: 同类之间，只比分身多少。
lines.en: Between kin, we only compare clone counts.
Ask the original about that.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣就是我的影子。
lines.en: My partner is my own shadow.
Splitting keeps me busy enough.
There's no such thing between shadows.
Ask again, and I'll split one more.

lines.zh: 我捡东西？影子不拿重物。
lines.en: Me, pick things up? Shadows don't carry weight.

lines.zh: 那颗珍珠是我的战利品。
lines.en: That pearl is my trophy.
Don't reach out, the drop belongs to the shadow.

lines.zh: 我只会捡起自己的碎片。
lines.en: I only pick up my own fragments.
Put it down, that's not for you.
Something's on the ground, but I don't want it.
Shadows don't need a pack.
Even if I picked it up, I couldn't carry it off.
My clone will pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 掉落物在梦魇里会消失。
lines.en: Drops fade away in the Nightmare.
The shadow moved, it's you.

lines.zh: 又分裂出一个我，你打不完。
lines.en: Another me splits off; you can't kill us all.
One target, plenty to share.
You stepped into my layer.
The original will remember your face.
Locked on, the splitting begins.
You carry the scent of the living.
Stop hiding, shadows find you.
Four directions, all eyes.
You chose the wrong path.
No one I fix on can escape.
This layer is mine to patrol.
You stepped where you shouldn't.
The shadow has circled behind you.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个，我们很多。
lines.en: One target, many of us.
The encirclement starts, don't blame me.
Closing the net slowly, no rush.
You go left, the shadow goes right.
One more clone just appeared.
The breathing gets closer.

lines.zh: 我一分为二，你分得清吗？
lines.en: I split in two; can you tell which is me?
Look back, I'm ahead of you.
This mist helps me.
Don't stop, stopping is worse.
Shadows crawl over the ground.
You're surrounded in the middle.
The original is watching from behind.
Every me is waiting for you.
Cutting any of me won't help.
The footsteps are fake.
Run more, and there'll be more splits.
Your shadow is showing me the way.
Before the mist clears, you won't leave.
The more tense you get, the clearer I see.
Don't look back and count, you'll miscount.
The circle's closing, do you hear it.
This one's from the shadow.
Don't just guard the front.
Did you block me, or it?
Claws slash, taste of nightmare.
Hurts? The original hasn't struck yet.

lines.zh: 我打一下，就多一个打你。
lines.en: One hit from me, one more to hit you.
The shadow counts your wounds.
Wherever you dodge, it's my hand.
This claw comes from behind you.
Don't blink, the next strike is close.
Your blood darkens the mist.
We take turns, never tired.
Hit landed, the shadow smiles.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的克隆跟一步。
lines.en: You step back; my clone steps with you.
This one tests you for the original.
The claws aren't deep, but there are many.
Listen, the claw marks are ringing.
Block all you want, you can't block a crowd.
Shadows seep in through the wound.
This blow, you won't remember who dealt it.
First layer of Nightmare, the shadow wakes.
I'm here, with my copies.
One more me in the mist.
Squeezed out of the dream.
The original opens its eyes, and I take shape.
This layer is lively again.
Shadow lands, seeks a target first.
I'm born, then I replicate.
The mist parts, I rise.
Another me, from the dark.
Footprints arrive first, then me.
Don't fear, I'm only the beginning.
Firelight outlines me, and it stings.
Falling scatters a bit of the shadow too.
Nightmare water floods into the shadow.
Blown apart, and I fill in another.
The arrow pierces the shadow, leaving a hole.
Magic leaves me nowhere to hide.
Hungry? Shadows never eat.
Lightning strikes, the shadow flinches.
The void pulls at this shell.
